styles.name: Slate grey organic cotton bib apron with 2 mitred hip pockets, self fabric adjustable neck strap with cocoa fabric loop, longer waist ties — Oliver Harvey, Knoops
styles.desc: BIB APRON · Two mitred hip pockets · Self fabric adjustable neck strap through two antique brass sliders, with a stud-fastened loop in the cocoa fabric in place of the leather loop · LONGER self fabric waist ties, box stitched to secure · Knoops logo embroidered to the top centre of the bib
styles.lectra: APP0630, variant KNOOPS — cut the fabric loop in the cocoa cloth 16 cm long x 7 cm wide, 1 per garment; cut the neck strap 86 cm long
fabrics: Slate grey 100% organic cotton 260 gsm X149ECO-AM308 (Tiajo) — rating 0.70 m; All Costings has 0.7025 m from the cutting room's marker KNOOPS01, 2.81 m for 4; the sheet gives the location as A6, Sage holds the cloth at A3
Cocoa 100% organic cotton 260 gsm X149ECO-AM307 (Tiajo) for the fabric loop — rating 0.01 m; marker KNOOPSA lays 21; the sheet gives the location as A6, Sage holds the cloth at A4
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S DARK GREY 09975 for the main stitching — cost per metre
THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S COCOA BROWN 08975 for the fabric loop — cost per metre
Oliver Harvey woven label, set 4 cm down from the right side seam as worn.
Oliver Harvey care label: 100% organic cotton · 40° wash · do not bleach · 2 dot iron · P dry clean · tumble dry low. Set 4 cm down from the top of the finished right side seam as worn.
25 mm SAB BUCK AB triglide x 2 (New Lace). As there is no stock of the single brass slider, use two of the double brass slider. No Sage code on the trims list.
Set to the side of the left pocket as worn, level with the top edge.

2 x female studs set to the fabric loop, 2 x male studs set to the bib apron; use the markers. The sheet gives no stud quality: the OHAPP0786 sheets name New Lace 050B/C and 050B/D, which Sage holds as CMP-STD-CAP-050-929 / CMP-STD-SOC-050-929.
mfg: Embroidery: the Knoops logo set to the top centre of the bib — see CUSTOMER BRANDING.
Cutting: cut the neck strap 86 cm long. Cut the fabric loop in the cocoa cloth 16 cm long x 7 cm wide, 1 per garment.
Set the bib facing. Top of the bib 6 mm topstitched. Fold in 10 mm to neaten the lower edge; edgestitch the lower edge of the facing, which forms 5.5 cm topstitching to the front.
Armhole double turned, topstitching to finish 6 mm from the edge.
Hem double turned, topstitching to finish 12 mm from the edge.
Sides double turned, topstitching to finish 12 mm from the edge. Note: neaten the armholes before the side seam is neatened.
Set the pocket hems: double turn 1 + 2 cm and topstitch 1.8 cm.

Set the pockets to the apron: base of the pocket 24 cm up from the finished hem and 5 cm in from the finished side seam. Edgestitch in position. Stitch a triangle tack to the top of each pocket. Set the tax tab to the top of the left pocket as worn.

Make the neck strap: fold in half and enclose the raw edges, to finish 25 mm wide to fit the sliders. Edgestitch the long edge to close the seam. Thread through the slider and secure to the slider. Insert the bar and stitch down to form a loop.

Set the neck strap to the left side of the bib top as worn: end of the strap level with the bib topstitching and side of the strap level with the 6 mm topstitch of the apron. Cross and box stitch to the width of the strap.
Make the waist ties: bag out both ends, fold in half and enclose the raw edges. Edgestitch the long edge to close the seam.

Set the waist ties to the side seams, 3 cm over onto the apron, with the top edge of the tie level with the stitching of the armhole. Box and cross stitch into position to the width of the strap by 3 cm.
Make the fabric loop in the cocoa cloth, stitched in the cocoa brown thread: fold in half and bag out both ends. Edgestitch the long edge.
fin: Set 2 female studs to the fabric loop, use the marker. Set 2 male studs to the apron, use the marker. Studs on the bib: the top stud faces to the back and the bottom stud faces to the front.
Check, trim, press and fold. Tissue and set the product label.

Rating 0.70 m on the sheet; All Costings has 0.7025 m from marker KNOOPS01 (2.81 m for 4), the loop on marker KNOOPSA at 21 a lay. The sheet's sketch and the Knoops logo are in works-orders/OHKNAPP0630241-Knoops.xlsx.
